title: Haas Rotary Operators Manual 96-0315 Rev K — HRT/TRT Routine Inspection
locator: Routine inspection section for specific HRT/TRT rotary units: platter face/ID runout, worm play, worm-to-gear backlash, system backlash and face-gear popout
notes: Older product-family-specific operator/service instructions. It is useful as an example that component worm play, gear-pair backlash, system-level backlash and face-gear popout are separate checks, but its numerical settings and procedures must not be applied to other models or current equipment. PDF is linked only and not archived.
